messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: inference-api error-rate spike — rule=log_error_rate_v2 triggered (5m > 5%). SRE on call: @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: on it. quick context? any customer-facing impact?

maria.g: seeing a bump in 5xxs from the v2 model pool starting ~1938456200. Traffic is normal, but a subset of nodes return `503` and we get retries. Affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

arpit.k: logs look noisy — lots of `healthcheck` 502s from kube-probes and some downstream gateway 503s during small maintenance window. Could be correlation not causation.

observability-bot: current counts (5m): total_requests=124k, errors=7,250 (5.84%). Top error signatures:
- gateway:503 - 3,900
- kube-probe:502 healthcheck - 1,800
- reroute-timeout - 1,000

devops-jc: if kube-probe 502s are inflating the rule we should exclude them at query level rather than muting alerts. we can push a temporary rule tweak + a PR for a longer-term signature.

maria.g: agree. plan: 1) enable pager quiet-mode for this rule for 1h while we test, 2) add regex to exclude kube-probe lines, 3) create a dedicated dashboard panel to watch region/gateway distribution, 4) add a log signature for gateway:503 transient case.

sre-oncall: set the quiet-mode to 1h now. will coordinate the changes. @devops-jc can you propose the query change?

devops-jc: proposed log query BEFORE:

```
index=prod_logs service=inference-api level=error | stats count() by error_message
```

AFTER (temporary exclusion):

```
index=prod_logs service=inference-api level=error NOT message="*kube-probe*" | stats count() by error_message
```

Also adding a signature rule to capture `gateway:503` with a fingerprint on `request_id` so we can track it separately.

arpit.k: lgtm. also suggest raising the 5m threshold from 5% -> 8% for this rule while we confirm and avoid noisy pages. mark it as temporary and auto-revert in 2h.

maria.g: Doing quick customer check: CX reports 6 inbound tickets in last 30m, mostly transient errors that auto-retried. No escalations yet. tagging @customer-success.

customer-success: confirming — users saw brief failures but most sessions recovered. we have two customers who asked for ETA; will keep them updated.

observability-bot: applied temporary query change and threshold bump. Quiet-mode enabled for 1h. New dashboard panel created: `inference-api/errors/by_gateway_region` (chart).

sre-oncall: rolling this out to prod now. leaving a runbook note. PR referenced here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/observability/pulls/412 (WIP).

maria.g: quick regex I'm about to add to the rule to filter probe noise:

```
NOT message =~ /kube-probe|healthcheck|Readiness probe/i
```

This should drop ~25% of the spike. Also adding a signature for `gateway:503` with sample pattern:

```
pattern: /gateway.*status=503.*request_id=(?<rid>[^\s]+)/
fingerprint: rid
```

arpit.k: nice. once signature is active we can route those errors to a lower-severity metric and create a specific alert on it (so it's visible but not noisy).

devops-jc: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/observability/pulls/412 — includes the query change + regex + dashboard JSON + rollout note. tagging @luca for review.

luca: reviewing now. small nit: add an expiration field to the temporary threshold tweak so it auto-reverts. otherwise lgtm.

observability-bot: threshold bump scheduled to auto-revert at 1938460500 (approx 1 hour). quiet-mode will expire at 1938457189.

sre-oncall: all changes applied. monitoring is greening up. errors down to 3.1% on the adjusted query.

maria.g: sending follow-up message to affected customers and scheduling a 30-min post-incident sync in 1.5h to decide permanency of signature + dashboard.

customer-success: thanks — will send status update to impacted customers now. :white_check_mark:

arpit.k: follow-up items:
- make `gateway:503` a first-class signature with its own alert at severity=low
- add dashboard row for `by node` so we can spot noisy hosts
- add runbook note about when to increase/decrease thresholds (include example regex)
- triage whether a kernel upgrade or transient network flakiness caused probe 502s

sre-oncall: filing postmortem stub and assigning owners. if metrics stay stable I'll close the page in 30m.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: rule stabilized below threshold for 20m. Paging cleared. Postmortem scheduled.

sre-oncall: closing thread — thanks team. :pray: anyone who touched the PR please ping for the postmortem review.
